content: Congratulations! You have been selected for the internship program. Your welcome letter and batch code are attached. To confirm your enrolment, complete the registration form within 24 hours. A refundable registration fee of Rs. 499 is required to secure your position. After payment, upload the payment screenshot and transaction ID. You can also refer a friend and receive a referral reward. Flexible joining date available. Selected candidates will receive the internship certificate after completion.
